name: E2E-AFD-002 — AFD批次管理（sourceId聚合+分布式锁+append/submit）
description: 验证F88MaterialGenerateExecuteCronTrigger的AFD批次管理规则：sourceId={yyyyMMdd}_{pipelineId} → 先queryBatch查已有批次 → 有则append → 无则Tair分布式锁(自旋5s/60s上限) → double-check → submit新建批次 → 分组key={pipelineId}_{strategyId}
module: 上游素材生产链路/AFD回调

steps.expression: return (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: 'AFD批次管理', batchRules: { sourceId: '{yyyyMMdd}_{pipelineId}', groupKey: '{pipelineId}_{strategyId}', submitRequest: { sourceType: 'F88_MATERIAL', relationType: 'link', relationId: 'Long.valueOf(pipelineId)', batchName: 'F88素材生成_{yyyyMMdd}', immediateStart: true } }, flow: ['1.PENDING记录→按groupKey(pipelineId_strategyId)分组', '2.每组更新为EXECUTING', '3.构建inputData(item_id,seller_id,origin_img_url,link_id,target_strategy_id,process_mode,f88_stage,cate_id,output_ratio,recordId,id)', '4.sourceId={yyyyMMdd}_{pipelineId}', '5.queryBatch查已有批次', '6.有→append追加', '7.无→spinLock(Tair,5s间隔,60s上限)', '8.double-check再查一次', '9.仍无→submit新建批次', '10.提交成功→更新processInfo(batchId)', '11.更新AI预审记录生成状态', '12.回写AFD通道状态为processing'], inputDataFields: ['item_id','seller_id','origin_img_url','link_id','target_strategy_id','process_mode','f88_stage','cate_id','cate_name','output_ratio','recordId','id'] }; })()

steps.description: 验证 定义AFD批次管理规则 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { return { validation: 'AFD批次管理规则', checks: [ { name: 'sourceId格式', expected: '{yyyyMMdd}_{pipelineId}', rule: '同一天同链路聚合到一个批次', pass: true }, { name: '分组key', expected: '{pipelineId}_{strategyId}', rule: '同链路同策略的任务聚合', pass: true }, { name: '已有批次', expected: 'append追加', rule: 'queryBatch→有→append(无并发风险)', pass: true }, { name: '无批次', expected: '分布式锁+submit', rule: 'Tair锁→double-check→submit', pass: true }, { name: '自旋锁', expected: '5s间隔/60s上限', rule: 'maxAttempts=60,intervalMs=5000', pass: true }, { name: 'double-check', expected: '拿锁后再查', rule: '防止等待期间被其他线程创建', pass: true }, { name: '通道回写', expected: '链路一→单图,链路二→批量', rule: 'replacePic→单图,generateMaterial→所有劣质图', pass: true } ] }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在多条PENDING记录，分属不同pipelineId和strategyId
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.PENDING记录按groupKey分组 2.每组先查已有批次 3.有→append 4.无→加锁+double-check+submit 5.验证sourceId和batchName格式 6.验证通道状态回写
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①同一天同链路聚合到一个AFD批次 ②并发提交时分布式锁保证只有一个submit ③后续提交走append ④通道状态正确回写
riskPoints: 自旋锁超时(60s)会导致该分组提交失败
通道回写失败由writer内部指数退避重试5次兜底
